name: Umbrella
summary: Open umbrella with eight scalloped panels and a curved J handle, standing upright; for rain, weather and shelter scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the J handle tip sits on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the umbrella is about 500 px wide and 840 px tall; use about 0.4 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: spin = the canopy turns slightly back and forth; sway = the whole umbrella rocks a touch

author: krakujs
